18 April 2026​

[US] President Trump signs a major executive order today directing the FDA to expedite the review of psychedelic-based medical treatments.

Speakers note these substances were largely made illegal by the 1970 Controlled Substances Act, which they argued was passed to target specific social movements rather than based on the potential harm of the drugs. -- Fox 5, Atlanta




Happy Bicycle Day (psychedelic holiday)​

Bicycle Day is an unofficial celebration on April 19 of the psychedelic revolution and the first psychedelic trip on LSD by Albert Hofmann in 1943, in tandem with his bicycle ride home from Sandoz Labs.

It is commonly celebrated by ingesting psychedelics and riding a bike, sometimes in a parade, and often with psychedelic-themed festivities.
